Method of Attack: Malicious code injection to infect developers with malware
Supply-chain attack via trojanized software updaters and backdoored binaries
Downloading and executing malicious payloads from command-and-control servers
Collecting system information and sending it to C&C servers
Using digitally signed binaries to avoid detection
Impacted Systems: Three unnamed South Korean companies (video gaming company, conglomerate holding company, pharmaceutical company)
Attack Vector: Trojanized software updaters and digitally signed binaries
Supply-chain compromise of software production process
Malicious payload delivery via backdoored games and software
Use of command-and-control servers for payload download and command execution
Indicators of Compromise: Use of valid digital certificates to sign malware
Registry key HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\{0753-6681-BD59-8819} set to 1 to prevent malware restart
Use of IPHLPAPI.dll in malware samples
HTTP POST and GET requests to C&C servers
Editable Google Docs used for C&C communication
